subject: Medford Soap Company Profile
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Michelle Corrado, owner and artisan of the Medford Soap Company, about her background, the origins of her business, and the challenges and rewards of running a small business in Medford.

items.title: Introduction of Michelle Corrado
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced the program and welcomed guest Michelle Corrado, owner of the Medford Soap Company.

items.title: Corrado's Personal and Professional Background
items.summary: Corrado shared her background as a lifelong Medford resident, Tufts University biology graduate, and practicing pharmacist of over 30 years.

items.title: Founding Medford Soap Company
items.summary: Corrado explained how falling down a soap-making video rabbit hole on TikTok in late 2022 inspired her to register her business in January 2023.

items.title: Challenges of Small Business Ownership
items.summary: Corrado discussed the physical and mental demands of running a solo business, economic pressures, and the lack of affordable retail space in Medford.

items.title: Advice for New Small Businesses
items.summary: Corrado advised aspiring entrepreneurs to align their efforts with clear goals and to start with low-risk opportunities like local craft fairs and farmer's markets.

items.title: Maintaining a Successful Business Mindset
items.summary: Corrado emphasized the need to manage finances strictly, keep an eye on profit margins, and remain resilient enough to retire products that fail to sell.

items.title: Competition and Natural Ingredients
items.summary: Corrado identified large bath and candle corporations as her primary competition and explained the health benefits of using natural, vegan soaps over standard commercial detergents.

items.title: Reflections on Business Growth
items.summary: Corrado reflected on starting her operation in her kitchen and gradually claiming more space in her basement as the company grew.

items.title: Key Product Distinctions
items.summary: Corrado detailed how her business stands out by utilizing clean ingredients, reducing packaging waste, and fundraising for the local community.

items.title: Top Sellers and Scent Selection
items.summary: Corrado shared details about her top-selling items, including the 'Man O' Man' soap and whipped body butters, explaining how customer demand guides her creative process.

items.title: Buying Products and Chamber of Commerce Support
items.summary: Corrado shared where to purchase her products online and locally, and recommended that micro-businesses utilize the Medford Chamber of Commerce to build local connections.
